description: This file is a Gradle build script (written in Groovy) responsible for configuring static weaving of JPA entities using EclipseLink in a Java project. It conditionally applies the configuration based on the presence of JPA entities and sets up the necessary tasks to perform static weaving.

methods.name: project.afterEvaluate
methods.description: Registers a callback to run after project evaluation to configure static weaving if applicable.

methods.name: project.plugins.hasPlugin
methods.description: Checks if a specific plugin (e.g., 'java') is applied to the project.

methods.name: logger.info
methods.description: Logs informational messages about the configuration process.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Creates a File object pointing to the specified path, used to locate 'persistence.xml'.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Configures copying of the persistence.xml file into the weaving directory.

methods.name: javaexec
methods.description: Executes the static weaving process via the specified main class, passing necessary arguments.
